# Three.js 0.160.1

Pinned, unmodified browser dependencies for the separate 3D workbench:

- `three.module.min.js`: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.160.1/build/three.module.min.js
- `OrbitControls.js`: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.160.1/examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js
- `LICENSE`: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.160.1/LICENSE

The workbench imports these local copies, so it does not contact a CDN at runtime.
Three.js and OrbitControls are covered by the included MIT license.
